title: Into the abyss
body:
I have no idea who I am speaking to right now. I made this with the intent of just writing things occasionally. For the moment I will keep this to myself, and just be writing into the abyss. Eventually though someone will read this, someone very special, or a day I was very bored. 

I will give no introduction to myself, just simple reclusive anonymity. 

Hello friend.
